subject.paper: From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws

assessment.scope: Grades apply only to the public artifact at the pinned commit and the reported HarnessFix benchmark/diagnosis claims; they do not grade all trace-guided repair methods or worker-side warrant extensions.

findings.details: The official repository preserves end-to-end repair pipelines, failure-analysis utilities, benchmark sampling/evaluation code, initial harnesses and final repaired harness snapshots. The public AppWorld validation gate directly implements resolved-count improvement plus target-metric and regression checks, while explicitly reporting cost without using cost as a Boolean admission condition.

The repository's RQ1 table reports three-run held-out averages including GAIA 43.3->61.7, SWE 45.3->57.3, AppWorld 36.7->43.0 and TB2 17.6->26.5, with reported held-out standard deviations 1.7, 1.7, 1.9 and 2.9 percentage points respectively. These summary values are preserved, but the underlying per-run generated evaluation outputs are not public in the repository.

README and .gitignore explicitly state that raw benchmark data, model traces, logs, generated evaluation outputs, failure-analysis results/memory and local sampled JSON/JSONL datasets are excluded. The tracked results directory contains only .gitkeep. This prevents exact reconstruction of the paper's three-run outcome chronology and task-level success sets from the repository alone.

requirements.txt lists dependencies without version pins. Several benchmarks also require external gated/downloaded data, Docker images or provider-specific model/API behavior. The GAIA sampling script is deterministic at the Python sampling layer (seed 42 and fixed level counts), but the repository does not pin the dataset revision or preserve the sampled task-id manifests, so exact historical sample reconstruction is not guaranteed from code alone.

docs/diagnosis_annotation.md publishes only aggregate per-benchmark/overall Fleiss-kappa values, while exp/rq2_failure_diagnosis.md publishes aggregate diagnosis scores. Repository search found no row-level adjudicated 80-trajectory label table or per-example model predictions. Therefore the 85.0/83.8/81.3/86.2/82.5 Full-HTIR metrics and kappa values cannot be independently recomputed from the public artifact.

Fresh public search found secondary summaries and at least one public fork, but no protocol-matched independent rerun publishing the same four benchmark splits, GPT-5-mini setup, three-run task-level outputs and HarnessFix headline deltas. Secondary pages restate the paper and are not independent replication evidence.

The worker's claim that HarnessFix provides a concrete trace-grounded, scoped repair plus regression-aware promotion mechanism is strongly artifact-supported. The public artifact does not independently reproduce the paper's headline gains, and it does not supply a component-level causal warrant oracle or repeated-selection-safe statistical contract. Those worker-side boundaries remain appropriate and should not be promoted into claims about demonstrated long-horizon safety.

continuation_checks.leanstral_protocol_match_search: No protocol-matched reproduction or immutable vendor-equivalent miniF2F manifest was found in this run; the public preserved third-party archive remains an unmatched protocol and should not be treated as a contradiction.
continuation_checks.driftlens_supplement_search: A fresh exact-term search did not surface the declared UC8 supplementary HDF5/replay payload; keep exact replay artifact-blocked rather than inferring failure.

exact_next_action: Inspect another under-audited C12 namespace with an executable official artifact and a plausible independent rerun/failure trail. Prefer evaluation, cross_field, long_horizon or neuroscience if their sealed source artifact exposes a source-qualified candidate whose numerical evidence grade could materially change. In parallel, only revisit HarnessFix if row-level RQ2 labels/generated evaluation outputs or a protocol-matched independent rerun appears; do not repeat source-only inspection of the unchanged commit.
